items.quote: Very happy with the new roof on my Jacksonville Florida home. Brendan and Bruce communicated very well. Let me select the shingles, drip edge and ventilation. Handled the scheduling, placement of materials, permitting and cleanup and let me know in advance. Got the work done on time as promised.
We recently had a new roof replacement completed with Alton. The experience was stellar from start to finish. The crew was always on time and completed the job before the timeframe originally quoted.

Alton Roofing came to the rescue to help us sell a rental property that had been in our family for 5 decades. They replaced the roof for us before closing and came back to take care of an issue that occurred during the process.
